source: RPCS3 patch.yml, "Unlock FPS" (Whatcookie, FlexBy, illusion, Score)

patches.note: bgt cr7 -> nop: leave the frame limiter's sleep loop after one pass

speaker-count getter: lwz r3,0(r9) -> li r3,6. The global it reads starts at 2 and the audio-out setup sets it to 6 on another thread; a sound setup that read it first mixed the whole session in the 2ch layout (the menu music's varying centre/LFE). From the Resistance PC port by Psyykosis (MIT). RES_SPEAKERS=0 keeps the original read.
direct mouse look (project/mouselook.cpp): the player look code before it integrates the look rates (lfs f1,0x3D0(r31))
direct mouse look: after the integration, before the pitch clamp (lfs f30,0x3F4(r31))
direct mouse look: the camera FOV setter's entry (f3 = horizontal FOV, degrees), for zoom

the engine's spin delay (32 x or r31,r31,r31, the Cell's db8cyc 8-cycle pause, then blr), called by the job manager's wait loops between polls of what an SPU job writes: an adaptive pause instead of a Mac core held at 100% (project/spinwait.cpp; RES_SPIN_SLEEP_US=0 turns it off)
